name: Sap / sparse four-live representative
notes:
Deal 3 arcane damage to target hero.

**Surge** - If this deals more than 3 damage to a hero, you may remove an energy counter from a permanent they control. Representative only: three_arcane_without_surge_preserves_energy_counter. Other pitch siblings, alternate targets and unexercised branches receive no credit. All four live/manual; only native entry-point actions. An actual ENERGY counter on generic Tunic is preserved at exactly base damage; the initial Hyper Driver/STEAM support was a discarded oracle-design error, never qualified.
